description: A DigitalOcean managed PostgreSQL database cluster with a single node, reachable over TLS with a password. Pick this when you need a Postgres database without running a server yourself. It can also create one database and one user for your app.
costHint: About $15 to $30 a month, depending on size.

variables.name: name
variables.label: Name
variables.description: Cluster name: 3 to 63 characters, starts with a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, not ending in a hyphen. Must not clash with another cluster's name.

variables.name: region
variables.label: Region
variables.description: Datacenter: nyc3 (New York), sfo3 (San Francisco), ams3 (Amsterdam), lon1 (London), fra1 (Frankfurt) or sgp1 (Singapore).

variables.name: size
variables.label: Size
variables.description: db-s-1vcpu-1gb (1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 10 GiB storage, about $15/month) or db-s-1vcpu-2gb (1 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 30 GiB storage, about $30/month). Always a single node, so not highly available.

variables.name: database_name
variables.label: Database
variables.description: Optional: a database to create. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, at most 63 characters; not defaultdb, postgres, template0 or template1. Leave it out to use the cluster's default database, defaultdb.

variables.name: user_name
variables.label: User
variables.description: Optional: a database user to create, whose password is generated by DigitalOcean. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, at most 63 characters; not doadmin or postgres, and not starting with pg_. Leave it out to use the cluster's admin user, doadmin.

outputs.name: port
outputs.description: Port to connect to. Connections must use TLS (sslmode=require).

outputs.name: database
outputs.description: Database to connect to: the one requested, or defaultdb.

outputs.name: user
outputs.description: User to connect as: the one requested, or doadmin.

outputs.name: uri
outputs.description: Connection URI for that user and database, including the password.
